name: idesy-scent
description: Official Indoeasy Scent Website — static site, deployed to a personal VPS via rsync

scripts.seo:sweep: python3 deploy/mojisweep.py *.html deploy/*.py deploy/*.sh docs/*.md js/*.js robots.txt sitemap.xml
scripts.seo:all: npm run seo:covers && npm run seo:images && npm run seo:inject && npm run seo:validate && npm run seo:sweep
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:dry && npm run deploy:live
scripts.deploy:live: rsync -avz --rsync-path="sudo -n rsync" --delete --exclude '.git' --exclude '.well-known' --exclude 'node_modules' --exclude '.wrangler' --exclude 'docs' --exclude 'deploy' --exclude 'img/ads' --exclude '__pycache__' --exclude 'package.json' --exclude 'package-lock.json' --exclude 'index.js' --exclude 'CNAME' --exclude '_headers' --exclude '.assetsignore' --exclude 'wrangler.toml' ./ idesys-vps:/home/admin/web/indoeasyscent.com/public_html/ && ssh idesys-vps 'sudo chown -R admin:admin /home/admin/web/indoeasyscent.com/public_html && find /home/admin/web/indoeasyscent.com/public_html -type d -exec chmod 755 {} + && find /home/admin/web/indoeasyscent.com/public_html -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +'

comment: Deploy lewat SSH alias 'idesys-vps' di ~/.ssh/config (user pandeandhika, key ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_vps). Ganti alias kalau hostname/user berubah. Selalu deploy:dry dulu.
